question: The point $(k,4)$ lies on the line joining $(1,2)$ and $(3,6)$. Using determinants, determine $k$.
explanation:
Step 1: Use the determinant condition
Three points lying on the same line satisfy $$\begin{vmatrix}1&2&1\\3&6&1\\k&4&1\end{vmatrix}=0$$
Step 2: Expand the determinant
Expanding along the first row gives $$1(6-4)-2(3-k)+(12-6k)=0$$
Step 3: Simplify
Thus, $$2-6+2k+12-6k=0$$ which gives $$8-4k=0$$
Step 4: Determine the parameter
Therefore, $$k=2$$
